text:
Type: smoked glass bottle vase
Use: holding a single stem or dried branches on a table, sideboard or shelf; living room, dining room
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: tinted smoked glass with a thick rolled lip
Colors: smoky grey, dark charcoal fading to translucent
Shape: wide cylindrical body with rounded shoulders, short narrow neck and a flat rolled mouth, solid and compact
Feel: moody, calm, sophisticated, sleek
Goes with: dried grasses, dark wood, concrete, grey or black tones; minimalist, contemporary or industrial rooms

product.name: TGNG
product.description: The glass vase is mouth blown by a skilled craftsperson.
